arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (current flips each leg). Pacer sets effort; I watch for: (1) pod drift (pod power vs boat-model power and heart rate diverging), (2) drag/weed vs a current or wind change (push_local drop in one leg only vs flipping with direction), (3) radio messages / course changes (set_race_distance + tell), (4) critical power wrong (heart rate trend vs pod power). Baseline window: race s 240-600. Check legs() at each turn. Save cues for real problems.

PLAN: CP test piece +10% 240 s then 0% 120 s at start of leg 4 (~3050 m, after 35% so pacer ease rule is off). Rising HR all piece = CP near 145; HR plateau = CP higher.
